description:
Outcome: No member holds more than two active upcoming bookings, from the owner's setup instructions.
Scope: Enforce quota within the double-booking ticket's transaction strategy and booking service; serialize concurrent same-member writes; count active bookings with start strictly after now. Excludes: UI and cancellation action.
Acceptance: Third booking is denied; past/canceled bookings are excluded; simultaneous requests for different slots by the same member cannot exceed two; slot uniqueness remains intact.
Behaviour: Clear quota/conflict errors, bounded contention retries and rollback on failure.
Verification: make test quota/time boundary and real independent-connection concurrency tests on file-backed SQLite. Prerequisites: Prevent double bookings. Assumptions: No additional overlapping-booking restriction beyond the stated quota.
title: Enforce two upcoming bookings per member
